paragraphs: Info Page
If you cultivate cannabis to sell, you must tell the Office of Cannabis how you will run you business.
We will ask you for the following information on the cultivation operations form of the cannabis business application.

sections.heading: Your canopy space
paragraphs: We will ask you for the total amount of square feet you plan on using for cultivation, including vertical shelving.
For dedicated cultivators, this space cannot be over 22,000 square feet. For microbusinesses doing cultivation, this space cannot be over 10,000 square feet.
Your nursery area does not count toward total cultivation space. However, you cannot sell your immature plants.
We will also ask you for the total wattage used by your lighting, across cultivation and nursery spaces.

sections.heading: Water source
paragraphs: We will ask if you will use a source other than City water.
If you are not using City water, we will ask for:
Name of your water source
Name of your water supplier
Point of diversion for your water source

sections.heading: Pesticides
paragraphs: We will ask which of the legal pesticides you will use.

sections.heading: Fertilizers
paragraphs: We will ask for the chemical name of any fertilizers you will use.
We will also ask how you will dilute and store your fertilizers.

sections.heading: Propagation materials
paragraphs: We will ask about the materials you will use when growing cannabis plants from seeds, seedlings, or cuttings. These materials include:
Rockwool
Perlite
Expanded Clay Pellets/LECA/Hydroton
Coco Coir/Perlite Blend
Coco Coir/Expanded Clay Blend
Peat Moss Plugs
Coco Coir Plugs
Bubbleponics/Aquaponics systems, using plant collars and/or 1” net pots
We will also ask which methods of propagation you will use:
Seeds
Cuttings
Seedlings
Grafting
Tissue culture

sections.heading: Reducing odors outside
paragraphs: You must have ventilation so the public cannot smell cannabis from outside.
We will ask if you will use charcoal filters to vent air to the outside. We will also ask about other methods you will use to reduce odors.
